entities.summary: Falmer Stadium, currently known as the American Express Stadium for sponsorship reasons and more commonly referred to as the Amex, is a football stadium in Brighton and Hove, East Sussex, England. With a capacity of 31,876, it is the second-largest stadium in South East England, and the 30th-largest stadium in the United Kingdom.
